name: Hamnel wa Obakana Ookami o Hattensasetai!!
original_name: ハムネルはおバカなオオカミを発展させたい！！
source:
Hamnel (the protagonist) arrives to help develop the Wolf planet. However his true identity is a hamster!? On a planet full of wolves, Hamnel struggles to keep his true identity a secret. A lighthearted novel about the interactions between Ain (the creator ofthe planet) and Hamnel.


[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/hamuneru.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角“哈姆内尔”奉命前来协助开拓“狼之星”——然而他的真实身份竟然是一只仓鼠！？在一颗遍地都是恶狼的星球上，哈姆内尔拼命隐瞒着自己的真身。这是一部描绘星球造物主艾因与哈姆内尔之间愉快互动的轻松短篇视觉小说。


[译自[url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/hamuneru.html]官方网站[/url]]
